verdict.rationale: Rippling's global payroll pages say it can pay contractors worldwide in a single system without waiting on transfers or conversion, and they claim global compliance in general terms. Nothing in the evidence explicitly confirms payouts in each contractor's local currency, and there is no mention of compliant contractor contracts or agreement generation. Missing for 10: explicit local-currency contractor payouts, compliant contractor contract creation/classification, independent or hands-on corroboration.
